requirements.requirement: The system must include an explainability field in the evaluate_care_facade response payload when scoring data is available.
The system must populate the explainability field using the schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-ST-001.
The system must invoke normalization and contribution logic from EVAL-EXPLAIN-ST-002 to generate explainability data.
The system must ensure each measure in the explainability output contains measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score.
The system must preserve existing response fields and structure in evaluate_care_facade without regression when adding explainability.
The system must ensure the explainability payload is compatible with existing tool routing and response handling logic.
The system must return deterministic explainability results for identical input data across repeated calls.
The system must include explainability data only for measures used in the final score calculation.
The system must maintain consistent ordering of measures in the explainability output across responses.
The system must ensure that the sum of contribution_to_final_score values equals the final score within an acceptable tolerance.
The system must gracefully omit the explainability field if upstream scoring logic fails and still return a valid base response.
The system must return an empty explainability array when no measure data is available rather than null or malformed data.
The system must not throw unhandled exceptions when explainability computation inputs are partially missing.
The system must ensure that adding explainability does not increase response latency beyond acceptable facade thresholds.
The system must serialize the explainability payload in a format compatible with downstream API exposure without additional transformation.
